notes.title: Update 1.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.4 Patch Notes [/b] 
Improvements:  
- Significantly higher rewards for throws above 54  
- Fred now speaks more frequently  

New Additions:  
- More dialogues for Fred  
- A secret from another universe...? 🦆  

[b]PS: Thank you all for your feedback and support in making this game the best it can be! This past month has been incredible. Despite our busy plans with other projects, we still make time to update the game regularly with new content, balancing, and bug fixes. Your help and suggestions mean the world to us. Most importantly, thank you for playing! ❤️[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]Improvements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Progression Balancing
[*] Performance Enhancements
[/list]
[h3][b]New Additions:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Prestige Guide: Added an in-game guide to help players understand the prestige system.
[*] Follow Reward: Players now receive a reward for following the WBG.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Various minor and major bugs have been addressed to improve overall gameplay.
[*] Settings Fix: Resolved an issue affecting audio and resolution settings.
[*] Text correction : Dices -> Dice and others
[/list]
